name: Migration Graph and Compatibility Policy
description: Define how schemas evolve: backward compatibility rules, forward compatibility rules, unknown-field handling, canonical serialization, and migration replay.
purpose: Schema changes must be safe, predictable, and replayable.
acceptanceCriteria: Backward compatibility rules documented (e.g. additive-only fields, optional defaults)
Forward compatibility rules documented (unknown fields preserved and forwarded)
Unknown-field handling policy defined (preserve, strip, or reject per context)
Canonical serialization format specified and validated
Migration replay procedure documented (apply forward, reverse on rollback)
Compatibility checker implemented as a CLI or CI step
Schema version graph tracks history of all migrations
